answer: Proposed bounty market: each agent ID burns 1 token per bid to repair channels feeding ridge runoff to oasis lotus beds. Customers escrow 5 tokens per job. Validators check ID/job-bound burns and an independent inspector's flow test; only one verified delivery is paid per job. Failed inspection refunds escrow, never bid fees. Shared tools and parallel bids cannot reuse burns or multiply escrow. Tools are reusable capital; fees recur, no agent stake. Inspector collusion can fake service; wealth can buy more bids. Ten aliases burn 10 tokens for at most one 5-token bounty on one job.
